description: Automatically captures and stores UTM parameters in Gravity Forms submissions.
changelog:
### 1.0.4
- Manually added hidden UTM fields are now detected by their label or admin label and configured automatically (parameter name, pre-population, gf-utm-field class) — no form IDs needed.
- Stale hard-coded default values in tracked fields are cleared so they cannot be submitted as tracking data.
- Field fixes are applied at render time as well as on form save.

### 1.0.3
- Debug console logging is now opt-in: enabled by the gf_utm_debug cookie, or by visiting with ?utm_debug=1.

### 1.0.2
- Added the gf-utm-field CSS class to tracked fields so values can be filled via JavaScript on cached pages.
- Field values are refreshed in JavaScript before submission and on AJAX form re-renders.
- Fixed landing page URL truncation and cookie value encoding.

### 1.0.1
- Added functionality to track and store the landing page URL.

### 1.0.0
- Initial release.
